name: disabled-reason
title: Disabled reason
description: Say why a control is unavailable: it stays focusable with aria-disabled, shows the reason on hover, focus and tap, and refuses the click.
docs: Wrap one control and pass disabled and reason; do not also set disabled on the control. For a select or a menu wrap its trigger (SelectTrigger), not its root, which renders no element to refuse; the arrow keys and typing that would open or change it are refused too, and a refused Button does not dip on a press or change on hover. It sets aria-disabled instead of the native attribute, so the control stays in the tab order, is read as unavailable, and refuses the click, Enter and Space (a text field becomes read-only). The reason shows in a tooltip on hover, on focus and when the control is tapped, and is tied in with aria-describedby. inline prints it under the control, always or with 'touch' only where there is no hover; put the pair in a block or column container. With disabled false nothing is left behind, the markup is the control's own, and the control keeps its focus.
